full_page.content:
Page 19 January 14 Mrs. Hattie Clark - 54 - Goitre & threatening stomach. was to have 2nd Xray Examination yesterday in Receiving Hospt'l - had to leave in a faint ....
Miss Edna Bauer - 42 - Mervepis - Bk. - now on probation. .....
Feb. 11 comes To-day O.K. though a little upset on account of report from hospital - cancer. They want her back ... "nothing doin."
Mrs. Vera Simmons - 38 - goitre and heart trouble; had operation on it 6 yrs ago; now threatening again; has six children .... youngest only 1 year.
James Egan -44- Hemroids
Mrs. Mary Gillis again - prayed for last week - Brother here now from Alberta Ca.
Thomas Bogucki - 46 - sort of paralisis ... creeping ... unable to walk for 4 months ...
Mrs. Cicl. Vander Meulen - 21 - wandered away from husband and baby ..
E'd Dickman - 41 - Lutherin - ruptured apend. ..
Page 20 Jan. 19 Margaret Munz - 32 - of Cleveland, Stroke shortly befor Xmas, has 3 small children. Oldest sister leaving on bus To-day quite upset, asks for earnest prayers
Ellen Maynes - 78 - slipped on step yesterday - breaking hip and Elboe Clara Langdon - 83
Martha Rozner - meets ingratitude.
Paul J. Schultz - 69 - in coma since Thursday - Blood trans. To-day. Dr. 01k. - losing hearing Ida Baker - 69 - fears cancerous
